creative_brief.emotional_promise: A small pause made tangible: one gentle nudge reveals the balance of a simple solid curve.
creative_brief.format_rationale: One object needs no assembly or rules. Two faces provide a visual first use and a compact reset and care reference, with 8 mm safe margins and no bleed or binding.
creative_brief.physical_format: Two-sided A6 portrait owner card, 105 x 148 mm
typography: Body and labels: embedded Bitstream Vera
creative_brief.visual_motif: The exact broad curved underside and level top establish the visual rhythm; a three-pose strip explains the whole-body motion.

findings: Page 1: two face tones may suggest a separate top piece.
Page 2: unlabelled motion poses can read as three objects.
Page 2: settling qualification should include print quality.
resolved_changes: Added one-solid-body shading caption below hero.
Added One rocker, three positions caption to motion strip.
Included desk level, friction and print quality in settling qualification.
